clause: Format family — PSD/PSB layered raster (rows 1,2, NRT) [STU-IO-006]

scope.summary: Implement StudioImportProfile + StudioExportRecipe for the layered-raster NRT family: .psd (row 1) and .psb large-document container (row 2), direction I·EP·X·RT. Preserve layers, groups, masks, adjustment/live-filter layers, linked/embedded objects, and blend modes as editable Studio primitives; bake unrepresentable features with a receipt; preservation-blob vendor-private structure and re-emit on same-family export. Wire into the five-artifact gate (MT-442) and fixture harness (MT-444).
acceptance_criteria: PSD/PSB I·EP·X·RT with layers/masks/blend preserved; fixtures+round-trip+receipts+recovery; manual entry
proof_targets: PSD/PSB fixtures + round-trip + receipt + recovery test
expected_tests: round-trip: import->export within bounded fidelity envelope (layers/groups/masks/blend modes preserved)
receipt: unsupported-feature receipt for baked features + preservation-blob re-emit
recovery: malformed/truncated .psd fails closed with receipt

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No Photoshop interop; primary raster round-trip family missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
